import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static List<long[]> dp_prev, dp_cur;
    static List<Integer> match_state;
    static List<List<Integer>> transition;
    static List<boolean[]> bfs_states;

    static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static int countBits(int x) {
        int cnt = 0;
        while (x != 0) {
            cnt += x & 1;
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    static int getHash(boolean[] state, int sz) {
        int pos = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < state.length; i++) {
            pos = (int) ((pos * 2L + (state[i] ? 1 : 0)) % sz);
        }
        return pos;
    }

    static boolean[] makeBit(int n) {
        boolean[] res = new boolean[128];
        res[n] = true;
        return res;
    }

    static int findOrInsert(boolean[] state, List<boolean[]> hashTable, List<Integer> hashIndex, int[] totalStates, int sz) {
        int pos = getHash(state, sz);
        while (true) {
            if (Arrays.equals(hashTable.get(pos), state)) {
                return hashIndex.get(pos);
            }
            boolean allFalse = true;
            for (boolean b : hashTable.get(pos)) {
                if (b) {
                    allFalse = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (allFalse) {
                hashTable.set(pos, state.clone());
                bfs_states.add(state.clone());
                hashIndex.set(pos, totalStates[0]);
                return totalStates[0]++;
            }
            pos = (pos + 1) % sz;
        }
    }

    static void precompute(int n) {
        int N = 1 << n;
        bfs_states = new ArrayList<>();
        boolean[] initialState = new boolean[128];
        initialState[0] = true;
        bfs_states.add(initialState);

        List<boolean[]> fixedSize = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            fixedSize.add(new boolean[128]);
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
            int cnt = countBits(mask);
            fixedSize.get(cnt)[mask] = true;
        }

        int hashTableSize = 0;
        if (n <= 6) {
            int[] sizes = {0, 5, 11, 37, 137, 821, 7529, 164184};
            hashTableSize = sizes[n];
        }

        List<boolean[]> hashTable = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> hashIndex = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < hashTableSize; i++) {
            hashTable.add(new boolean[128]);
            hashIndex.add(-1);
        }
        int[] totalStates = {1};

        List<List<Integer>> nextMask = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
            List<Integer> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int k = 0; k < 1; k++) {
                row.add(-1);
            }
            nextMask.add(row);
        }
        match_state = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            match_state.add(0);
        }

        for (int k = 0; k < totalStates[0]; k++) {
            boolean[] state = bfs_states.get(k);
            List<boolean[]> predHall = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                predHall.add(new boolean[128]);
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                if (state[mask]) {
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        predHall.get(i)[mask | (1 << i)] = true;
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                boolean[] nextState = state.clone();
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        for (int j = 0; j < 128; j++) {
                            if (predHall.get(i)[j]) nextState[j] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
                while (nextMask.get(mask).size() <= k) {
                    nextMask.get(mask).add(-1);
                }
                nextMask.get(mask).set(k, findOrInsert(nextState, hashTable, hashIndex, totalStates, hashTableSize));
            }

            for (int i = n; i >= 0; i--) {
                boolean found = false;
                for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                    if (state[mask] && fixedSize.get(i)[mask]) {
                        found = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                if (found) {
                    while (match_state.size() <= k) {
                        match_state.add(0);
                    }
                    match_state.set(k, i);
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        transition = nextMask;
        while (match_state.size() < totalStates[0]) {
            match_state.add(0);
        }
    }

    static long computeExpectedMatching(int n, int m, long[][] probMatrix) {
        int N = 1 << n;
        int totalStates = bfs_states.size();

        long[] dp_prev_arr = new long[totalStates];
        dp_prev_arr[0] = 1;
        dp_prev = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < totalStates; i++) {
            dp_prev.add(dp_prev_arr.clone());
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
            long[] dp_cur_arr = new long[totalStates];
            dp_cur = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < totalStates; i++) {
                dp_cur.add(dp_cur_arr.clone());
            }

            for (int mask = 0; mask < N; mask++) {
                long probability = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if ((mask & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                        probability = (probability * probMatrix[i][j]) % MOD;
                    } else {
                        probability = (probability * (MOD - probMatrix[i][j])) % MOD;
                    }
                }

                for (int k = 0; k < totalStates; k++) {
                    int nextStateIndex = transition.get(mask).get(k);
                    dp_cur_arr[nextStateIndex] = (dp_cur_arr[nextStateIndex] + probability * dp_prev_arr[k]) % MOD;
                }
            }

            dp_prev_arr = dp_cur_arr.clone();
            dp_prev = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < totalStates; i++) {
                dp_prev.add(dp_prev_arr.clone());
            }
        }

        long result = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < totalStates; k++) {
            if (match_state.get(k) == n) {
                result = (result + dp_prev_arr[k]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = n;

        precompute(n);

        long[][] p = new long[n][m];
        long inv100 = modPow(100, MOD - 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                long val = sc.nextLong();
                p[i][j] = (val * inv100) % MOD;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(computeExpectedMatching(n, m, p));
    }
}
